meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 14 (DECISIONS 036, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 4 new models, 15 quotes. Batch split: the fifth candidate, Apple Pro Display XDR, was NOT added — discontinued March 3, 2026 (EveryMac) and replaced by the Studio Display XDR; apple.com/shop/buy-mac/pro-display-xdr now serves the 'Buy Studio Display XDR' page, and the Meta Catalog feed returns Studio Display XDR rows for the query. The $3,299 candidate figure is the Studio Display XDR launch price (standard glass, tilt-and-height stand — Sweetwater $3,299, Sam's Club $3,299; Apple direct MFEP4LL/A nano-texture tilt-height $3,599, MFEQ4LL/A nano VESA $3,199), NOT a Pro Display XDR configuration — the Pro Display XDR was $4,999 standard glass / $5,999 nano-texture. The Studio Display XDR itself is a distinct new line (27-inch 5K mini-LED, 120Hz, from $3,299) and was NOT substituted in — it is a different model from the named candidate and needs its own batch. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{apple-pro-display-xdr,sony-mdr-7506,sony-pulse-headset,sony-linkbuds-clip,nintendo-n64-controller}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:53-19:00 UTC (10:53-11:00 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) Pro Display XDR $3,299 — see above, not added. (2) The MDR-7506 candidate price $114.99 is confirmed current at Sony direct (MSRP, JSON-LD); street price is $113 at Abt and Sweetwater. (3) The PULSE $99 (pre-order) figure is the NEW PlayStation Pulse headset (2026), NOT the PULSE 3D (CFI-ZWH1, 2020) — launches Nov 19, 2026, $99.99, pre-orders open since Oct 29 via PlayStation Direct and participating retailers; no hardware model number, retail MPN or UPC published yet. (4) The LinkBuds Clip candidate price $229.99 is the launch SRP — the current US street price is $198 (Best Buy, Sweetwater, BuyDig, Abt; comp. value $228). (5) The N64 controller candidate price $49.99 was the 2021 launch price — the current Nintendo direct price is $54.99 (JSON-LD InStock); a paid Nintendo Switch Online membership is required to purchase. All four identifier sets stay pending (single-source or no-source codes only — see catalog notes): MDR-7506 no UPC surfaced on any US spec page; Pulse no identifiers published yet; LinkBuds Clip Black UPC 027242934054 (BuyDig spec table only); N64 UPC 00045496894948 (Nintendo US page only) — all recorded in the catalog notes, identifiers left empty per the Adaptive Controller / DualSense / PULSE Elite precedent. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers.
